$comment: Provenance for every stock image on the site. Committed so licensing is auditable later,
which matters because 'where did this photo come from' is impossible to answer after the fact.
SOURCES: Unsplash (unsplash.com/license) and Pexels (pexels.com/license). Both permit
commercial use with no attribution required and no model/property release implied.
HARD RULE, enforced in review: NOTHING HERE MAY BE USED AS A LISTING PHOTO.
A stock image standing in for a home a buyer can go and view is misrepresentation under
FREC advertising rules. These are city, lifestyle, guide and site-level images only.
Every entry needs real alt text. `lib/validation/place.ts` refuses a hero key with an
empty alt, and an empty alt makes the image decorative in PropertyImage.
